feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Body found in woodland confirmed as missing Kelsey Hunter
articles.summary: The body of a woman found in woodland in Scotland has been identified as 20-year-old Kelsey Hunter, who went missing over the weekend.

articles.title: Police seek 100 concertgoers over mass evacuation at Manchester rap gig
articles.summary: A "small group of organised criminals" are being sought by police after an unknown substance sparked a mass evacuation at a Manchester concert.

articles.title: Poundland boss urges staff to feel pride in turnaround efforts
articles.summary: Poundland's boss has told staff to feel proud of their efforts to revitalise the discount retailer despite its collapse into administration earlier this week.

articles.title: 'Monster' jailed for coercing children into acts of violence and sexual activity online
articles.summary: A man who was part of an organised crime group that blackmailed and distributed indecent images of children has been jailed for 14-and-a-half years.

articles.title: Centrica warns on jobs after government snubs Rough gas storage deal
articles.summary: The FTSE-100 utility Centrica has warned that hundreds of jobs at its Rough gas storage facility off the Yorkshire coast are at risk and claimed that ministers had rejected proposals to bolster Britain's energy security.

articles.title: Christian social worker suffered discrimination over LGBT+ views, court rules
articles.summary: A Christian social worker suffered discrimination for his religious views on same-sex relationships, a court has ruled.

articles.title: MoD can't find contact details for half of veterans
articles.summary: The Ministry of Defence has published open letters to almost 100,000 veterans about their duty to mobilise in a crisis but it appears unable to find many people's direct contact details.

articles.title: MoD 'severely lacks expertise' to improve military housing
articles.summary: The Ministry of Defence lacks the skills and expertise needed to overhaul poor-quality housing for armed forces families, MPs have warned.

articles.title: 'The cold's here to stay': Snow possible - with ice warning issued
articles.summary: Snow could hit northern areas of the UK over the next few days, while a yellow ice warning has been issued in parts of the country.
